title: Supreme Court Mandates 10km Mining Buffer Zone Around All Notified Wetland Reserves
summary: Extends environmental protection order nationwide beyond Asan Wetland Reserve (Uttarakhand).

blocks.text: 🪝 Supreme Court Mandates 10km Mining Buffer Zone Around All Notified Wetland Reserves. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Extends environmental protection order nationwide beyond Asan Wetland Reserve (Uttarakhand).
Supreme Court of India mandated a compulsory 10 km eco-sensitive mining buffer zone around all notified Ramsar and wetland reserves.
Prohibits commercial mining, industrial discharge, and heavy quarrying within the buffer.
